notes.title: Rot Gut OST long-awaited update
notes.notes:
Hi,

It always bugged me that Rot Gut's OST needed a bit more love. I finally sat down and fixed it. Hope you like the little Quality of Life changes.

Also made a bundle for the game and OST called [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/53432/Rot_Gut__Double_Distilled_Edition/]Double Distilled[/url].

PeaCe,
-idn

notes.title: 2nd Bug fix for last two achievements is now live
notes.notes:
Hi,

I've tested and uploaded another patch for Rot Gut to address the bug related to last two achievements not getting unlocked properly.

You can check on my profile that I've got the achievements myself as well.

Hope this fixes issues.

Best,
idn

notes.title: Rot Gut's Original Soundtrack (OST) will be live soon!
notes.notes:

Just wanted to tell you guys due to high demand, we are releasing Rot Gut's Original Soundtrack (OST) as DLC for the main game.

Best,
Aidin
